		Overview
	

Cambrian-10M is a comprehensive dataset designed for instruction tuning, particularly in multimodal settings involving visual interaction data. The dataset is crafted to address the scarcity of high-quality multimodal instruction-tuning data and to maintain the language abilities of multimodal large language models… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/nyu-visionx/Cambrian-10M.
